name: Kasol

why.winter: Cold and quiet — snow on the peaks, cafés half-empty, real Parvati valley calm.
why.summer: Peak café season — the valley is green, treks to Kheerganga are open, everyone's here.
why.monsoon: Landslide season on the Bhuntar road — roads close without warning, skip Jul–Aug.
why.autumn: Crisp air, golden light, thinner crowds — arguably the best version of Kasol.

vibe: Hostel bonfires and café conversations — the easiest place in India to meet travellers.
hub: Overnight bus Delhi→Bhuntar, then 1.5h local bus

name: Jaipur
tagline: The pink city — forts, bazaars, rooftop sunsets

why.winter: Perfect fort weather — cool mornings at Amber, kachori and chai evenings.
why.summer: 40°C+ by April — sightseeing becomes a punishment, skip it.
why.monsoon: Sporadic rain cools things down; Sep is a decent quiet window.
why.autumn: The season begins — festivals, clear skies, bearable afternoons.

vibe: Big hostel scene, walking tours, easy trains onward — a classic solo circuit stop.

name: Palolem
tagline: South Goa's crescent beach, huts on the sand

why.winter: Peak Goa — beach huts open, silent discos, kayaks at sunrise. This is the postcard.
why.summer: April is hot and emptying out; by May most shacks are packed away.
why.monsoon: Rough seas, shuttered huts — moodily beautiful but nothing runs.
why.autumn: Shacks are being rebuilt through Oct; Nov opens the season fresh.

vibe: Solo-traveller default: hostels on the beach, everyone eats dinner with strangers.
hub: Fly/train to Madgaon (Margao), then 45 min taxi

name: Munnar
tagline: Tea gardens stacked to the horizon

why.winter: Cold, clear tea-garden mornings — the classic Munnar you came for.
why.summer: Warm but green; Apr–May is honeymoon-crowd season, book ahead.
why.monsoon: Jun–Jul is heavy rain and leeches; late Aug turns lush and misty.
why.autumn: Post-monsoon Munnar glows — waterfalls full, hills impossibly green.

vibe: More couples than backpackers, but scooter loops and viewpoints fill a solo day easily.
hub: Fly Kochi, then 4h winding bus/taxi climb

name: Rishikesh
tagline: Yoga, the Ganga, and river adrenaline

why.winter: Yoga-course season — cool days, campfires by the Ganga, rafting from Feb.
why.summer: Warming up fast; Mar–Apr still lovely, May is hot in the valley.
why.monsoon: River runs brown and high — rafting shut, trails slippery.
why.autumn: The sweet spot: rafting reopens, clear skies, cafés buzzing again.

vibe: Ashrams, hostels and rooftop cafés — solo travellers are the default here.
hub: Train/bus to Haridwar or fly Dehradun, then 1h

name: Hampi
tagline: Ruined empire in a boulder desert

why.winter: Golden mornings on the boulders, cycle between temples — Hampi at its best.
why.summer: A furnace by March-end; 40°C among bare rocks. Don't.
why.monsoon: Green paddy against brown boulders — atmospheric and quiet.
why.autumn: Cooling down, river flowing, climbers arriving — season's opening act.

vibe: Sunset points full of backpackers; guesthouse thalis eaten with strangers.
